tasks.title: Streaming checksum reconciler
tasks.prompt: Write Python 3.11 code only: function reconcile_checksums(src_iter, dst_iter) that compares two sorted streams of (pk, checksum) without loading all rows into memory. Return dict with missing_in_src, missing_in_dst, mismatched lists. Use iterators and O(1) extra memory.

tasks.title: Deadlock-aware retry executor
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for execute_with_retry(fn, max_attempts=5). Retries only deadlock/serialization errors with exponential backoff + jitter, preserves original traceback on final failure, and logs structured events.

tasks.title: Idempotent migration runner
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for class MigrationRunner using table schema_migrations(version text primary key, applied_at timestamptz, checksum text). Implement methods: should_apply, apply, verify_checksum, run_all. Enforce idempotency and checksum mismatch protection.

tasks.title: AST-based SQL rewrite helper
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for rewrite_oracle_sql(sql: str) -> str that uses token/AST-style transformations (no blind replace chain) to convert NVL->COALESCE, SYSDATE->CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, and ROWNUM filters to LIMIT when safe.

tasks.title: High-throughput batch copy
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for copy_table_in_batches(oracle_conn, pg_conn, table_name, batch_size=5000). Fetch Oracle rows with arraysize tuning, insert into PostgreSQL with execute_values, commit per batch, and return rows_copied + timing stats.

tasks.title: Deterministic schema diff engine
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for diff_schema(src_cols, dst_cols) returning ordered patch actions add/alter/drop. Must be deterministic, case-insensitive on identifiers, and preserve stable output order for CI snapshots.

tasks.title: Validation report builder
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for build_validation_report(results) that computes pass rate, p95 runtime, top 10 failures grouped by error signature, and outputs a markdown string table.

tasks.title: Bounded parallel executor
tasks.prompt: Write Python code only for run_parallel(tasks, worker_fn, max_workers=8) using ThreadPoolExecutor with bounded retries, timeout handling, and preserving input order in returned results.
